newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lung Kee unit delays IPO launch - paper.
newsitem.headline: Lung Kee unit delays IPO launch - paper.

text.p: Lung Kee (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd unit Lung Kee Metal Holdings (LKMH), has delayed the launch of its Singapore initial public offer (IPO), the Straits Times said on Monday.
Hong Kong-based LKMH, which designs and manufactures moulds used in plastic injection moulding, had originally planned to launch the offer on Tuesday, the newspaper said.

LKMH said last month it had received approval in principle from the Stock Exchange of Singapore for a primary main board listing. It said the IPO proceeds would be used to expand operations in China and Southeast Asia, and to penetrate new
But the Straits Times quoted an unnamed source as saying the issue launch had been postponed because of weak sentiment on the stock market.
An alternative date was under discussion, the paper said.
Several recent IPOs in Singapore have received a cool reception, especially those for firms not based in Singapore.
